description: This file defines the 'Config' class and related nested classes within the WPEFramework plugin namespace. It includes configuration options, JSON serialization, and system path utilities for plugin configuration management.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Main configuration class for the plugin, including nested classes for root configuration and system paths.

classes.name: Config::RootConfig
classes.description: Represents the root configuration settings, including mode, locator, user, and remote address.

classes.name: Config::RootObject
classes.description: Internal class for JSON serialization of the root config.

classes.name: Config::Setting
classes.description: Utility class for logging configuration settings.

methods.name: Config::DataPath
methods.description: Constructs the data path based on the base path and class name.

methods.name: Config::PersistentPath
methods.description: Constructs the persistent storage path based on the base path and postfix or callsign.

methods.name: Config::VolatilePath
methods.description: Constructs the volatile storage path based on the base path and postfix or callsign.

methods.name: Config::IsSameInstance
methods.description: Checks if another Config instance refers to the same plugin instance based on locator and class name.

methods.name: Config::HostType
methods.description: Determines the host type (local, container, distributed) based on mode.

methods.name: Config::IPV4UnicastNode
methods.description: Static method to get the IPv4 unicast node for a given interface name.
